honest_caveats: RV proxy is the squared daily close-to-close return (no intraday data on the free tier) — noisier than the literature's 5-minute realized variance; expect attenuated HAR coefficients.
Return distribution is Normal(0, sigma): fat tails are underpriced; far-tail bracket probabilities are understated. Student-t is a v2 ticket.
Synthetic ladder is centered on the prior close; the venue freezes its ladder at listing time overnight, so bracket alignment differs slightly on gap days.

Brier-vs-constant-vol says whether HAR-RV has vol-dynamics skill; it says NOTHING about edge vs the market. Only the market-implied comparison (needs accumulated book snaps on the box) can show that, and paper trading stays OFF until it does.
OHLC substrate is Yahoo's unofficial chart endpoint (Stooq is behind a JS wall as of 2026-07-02) — personal-use terms, no SLA; see kq/clients/yahoo_chart.py.
